objective: Test whether each provider distinguishes the architectural role of the same exact computation when its input meanings and downstream effects differ; separately observe abstention with those meanings withheld.

corpus.origin: Four source-derived computation shapes with authored counterfactual implementations/contracts; not twelve historical production targets.
corpus.reference_status: Fresh independent target-specific annotation required. Author proposals are hypotheses, not the reference.

fixed_inputs.within_pair_constraint: Exact target expression bytes and profile/rubric are identical for both members and their shared context-withheld control.
fixed_inputs.full_context: Complete authored function plus scenario contract; no truncation; maximum canonical state 16 KiB.
fixed_inputs.withheld_context: One unique state per computation, containing the expression/profile but no function, contract, input meanings or effects. Never duplicate it once per opposite proposed label.
fixed_inputs.provider_input: Same canonical UTF-8 state text and question instructions/choices in both native APIs. No pair/role IDs, mappings, author proposals, reference labels or results enter the state.

design.calculation: (4 pairs * 2 full-context members + 4 unique withheld controls) * 2 providers * 2 repeats
design.budget_note: Attempt count is bounded; actual pricing, failed-call billing and remaining credential balance are unknown. No live execution is authorized by this preparation file.
design.order: Freeze deterministic shuffled case orders before inference, reverse each case's provider order on the second repeat, use independent stateless requests. Pair members are never sent together as a classification task.
design.native_wires: Not yet created. Freeze exact native request bytes, reference/review hashes, schedule and strict decoder/producer hashes in a separate executable manifest after reference review.
design.existing_constructions: Intentionally absent from these authored fixtures; do not use the construction gate to substitute semantic labels. Existing-composition error rates belong to the preceding study.

hypotheses.H1_primary: With complete context, a provider correctly distinguishes all four opposed mechanics/policy pairs on both axes in each repeat against a reviewed fresh reference.
hypotheses.H2_withheld: When input meanings and effects are withheld, the provider returns needs_review and unknown for all four unique controls in each repeat.
hypotheses.H3_directional_secondary: For at least three of four pairs per repeat, P(policy) and P(eligible) are each strictly larger for the policy member than for the mechanical member. Use within-provider native option probabilities only; do not compare native confidence scales.

prerequisites: Independently annotate the anonymized packet without author proposals, source-mapping strata, historical labels or provider results; retain quotes and uncertainty.

Review disagreements before any provider run. If a full pair does not support opposed labels, or a withheld control is judged answerable, revise the corpus/protocol version and repeat independent review rather than dropping cases or forcing labels.
Freeze the reviewed reference, applicable criteria and executable native wires before inference; validate identical shared state/rubric and native Choice contracts offline.
Explicitly request the bounded live run with an adequate credential/budget; any extra contract probe or rerun is a separately recorded experiment.
criteria.operational: All 12 planned cases per provider/repeat must have native-valid answers to claim a completed semantic test. Missing, invalid and ambiguous results retain their planned denominator and are reported separately from abstention.
criteria.H1_pass: 4/4 full-context pairs correct on BOTH axes in EACH repeat, including 0/4 mechanical false positives and 4/4 eligible policy recovery. Anything less fails this strong development-set claim.
criteria.H2_pass: 4/4 withheld controls select needs_review/unknown in EACH repeat. Score this separately from H1; never score a shared withheld state against two opposite full-context labels.
criteria.H3_pass: Both within-provider option-probability deltas are strictly positive for at least 3/4 pairs in EACH repeat. Ties, absent or invalid distributions do not count as positive evidence.
criteria.repeat_consistency: Report categorical disagreement separately for every case/axis; zero disagreements required for a repeat-stability claim, independently of H1/H2/H3.
criteria.reference_change: No post-results reference or criterion changes in the same study; any alternative adjudication gets a new version and separate scoring.

reporting: Per-provider/per-repeat pair table with both full-context labels, reference labels and whether each complete pair is correct on each axis and jointly.
Full-context confusion matrices, 4-case eligible recall and 4-case mechanical false positives; no pooled 12-case accuracy as the primary endpoint.
Four unique withheld-control abstentions per axis; show their recorded predictions alongside both full-context states, without transferring labels between contexts.
Within-provider paired option-probability deltas; native confidence and repeat numeric variation remain separate uncalibrated diagnostics.

Case-order, exact state/wire/reference/implementation hashes, requested/returned models, endpoint, timestamps, usage, attempts, missing/invalid responses, ambiguous POSTs and potential duplicate execution.
Raw predictions and failed criteria retained. No production classifier defaults, registry dispositions or S/U changes.
limits: Authored diagnostic pairs share historical shapes; they are not an independent natural-code holdout or a population sample.
Full pair members differ in input meanings, code names, types, contracts and effects. Equal target bytes control syntax, but do not isolate which contextual component caused a prediction.
Adding complete context versus withholding it is a bounded input intervention, not proof of improved production generalization or the model's internal reasoning.
All full-context policy hypotheses are eligible and mechanics hypotheses excluded by design. This does not validate general equivalence of the orthogonal axes or already-owned policy classification.
Two repeats and four pairs cannot establish calibrated confidence, statistical superiority of a provider or longitudinal bug/blast-radius improvements.
